headline: Approved $7,400 in McGrath Landscaping work for tree removal and property maintenance, and approved paying a McGrath invoice when received.
summary: Members reviewed the financial report and approved McGrath's $7,400 estimate for tree removal and property maintenance. They also approved paying a McGrath invoice in October when it is received.
decisions: Approved paying the McGrath Landscaping invoice in October when it is received.
Approved McGrath Landscaping's estimate of $7,400 for tree removal ($2,200) and property maintenance ($5,200).
